verdict.line: You lose if you contest Renekton inside his Fury-stun chain before level 6; you win if you play off Hallowed Mist until your build comes online, where your 51.6% head-to-head win rate over 836 games takes over.

brief.thesis: Renekton has the lane and solo-kill edge because his Fury bar turns W (Ruthless Predator) into a 3-hit, 1.5s stun that shreds shields once it crosses 50, and his Q (Cull the Meek) sustains him through early trades. Gwen's structural answer is W (Hallowed Mist): Renekton can only target her once he physically walks into the mist, so she dictates when fights start rather than reacting to his dash. Once her core items are up, her Q (Snip Snip!) center-snip true damage and passive execute flip the matchup, matching the 51.6% win rate over 836 games.

theirWindow.what: His W (Ruthless Predator) upgrades to three slashes, a 1.5s stun, and shield destruction, and Cull the Meek's damage and heal both jump. If he's also transformed via R (Dominus, cooldown 120/100/80/80/80s) he has bonus health and a periodic Fury refill on top. Pop W (Hallowed Mist) and refuse to let him walk in during this window.

yourWindow.when: Fury below 50, his E (Slice and Dice) on cooldown
yourWindow.what: His W stun is only 0.75s and his Q/E damage is baseline, and Slice and Dice's cooldown (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) means no follow-up engage. Step in, land center Q (Snip Snip!) snips for the true damage and passive stacks, then E (Skip 'n Slash, cooldown 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s) out before he can reset.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The 51.4% win rate over 848 games (85.6% pick) comes from the sustain and AP needed to survive Renekton's early Q/W trades without losing lane presence.

boots.why: 58.7% pick at 51.3% over 534 games; the flat physical damage reduction directly blunts his auto-attacks and the Q/W all-in combo.

core.why: First item on the 64.1%-win, 33.1%-pick path; gives the AP and utility needed to start winning trades once his early Fury advantage fades.
Second item on the same path; the bonus damage to low-health targets pairs with Q's center-snip true damage to close out trades he survives early.
Completes the most-played core (33.1% pick); raw AP scaling is what turns Gwen's late-game execute threshold into kills.

situational.when: he is still landing his Fury-empowered W all-in on you past level 9
the game goes long and you need sustain through extended skirmishes instead of pure burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive force and the healing from Conqueror offsets Renekton's Q sustain in the extended melee trades this lane forces.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 63.9% of games at 50.3% win rate; Ignite punishes the healing on his Q (Cull the Meek) and secures kills when his all-in windows overextend.

playing.title: Hold W outside his range
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist only lets enemies target you once they enter it, so stand so Renekton has to walk in to start his stun chain — that choice is yours, not his.

playing.title: Track Fury before trading
playing.detail: Past 50 Fury his W becomes a 3-hit, 1.5s stun that destroys shields; never contest a fight in that window, wait for it to decay.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 all-in
playing.detail: Dominus grants bonus health and periodic Fury gain while active, making him far more dangerous the moment he hits 6. Play for farm, not trades, right after he levels up.

playing.title: Snipe with Q center, not the edge
playing.detail: Snip Snip! only deals true damage and applies your passive on center hits within the cone, so line up his hitbox dead-center rather than clipping the edge of the swing.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown
playing.detail: Slice and Dice sits at 16-10s depending on rank; the moment he's used it to engage, his mobility is gone and your E (Skip 'n Slash) dash-and-attack-speed window is safe to commit.

playing.title: Play for the scaling, not the kill
playing.detail: Your 51.6% head-to-head win rate over 836 games is earned mid-to-late, not in lane — prioritize farm and item timers over forcing all-ins you don't need.

playing.title: Ignite the heal
playing.detail: Cull the Meek heals him on every use; landing Ignite before a trade turns a close fight into a kill by cutting that sustain off.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample numbers are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch; the lane-timing, Fury-threshold, and trade-pattern reasoning is my own read of the kit.
